recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, cubist-inspired illustration featuring a stylized white bull or minotaur figure with a red heart on its chest, set against a background of sharp, flat color planes including red, purple, and green. The style uses heavy black outlines and distorted anatomical features reminiscent of mid-century modern surrealism.
coreVisualRelationships: The bull's horns frame the upper text area
The diagonal orientation of the secondary text mirrors the bull's neck angle
High-contrast white subject against saturated primary and secondary color fields
Juxtaposition of organic heart shape with rigid geometric background planes
coreInvariants: Flat, unshaded color blocks for the background
White border framing the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The bull figure occupies the central and lower-right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to dominate the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red heart located in the lower-right quadrant acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, follows the curve of the horns down to the face, and descends diagonally to the heart and secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with color fields and the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated Red and Deep Purple define the background structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White is used for the main figure and primary text to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Forest Green and Sky Blue provide secondary accents within the cubist planes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with minimal tonal gradation, creating a flat, graphic impact.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to primary and secondary hues

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke weight with high contrast
Ascenders and descenders integrated into the background shapes
Secondary text uses a slab-serif skeleton with a hollow outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' has a sharp, hook-like descender
The 'C' is oversized and integrates with the bull's horn
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a heavy, solid calligraphic display face and a light, outlined geometric slab serif.

preserve: Sharp angularity of the top text
Diagonal orientation of the bottom text
White fill for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, aggressive terminals of the top text
Matches the slab-serif structure of the diagonal text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cubist painting of a white minotaur with a red heart on its chest. Use flat planes of red, purple, and green in the background. Apply heavy black ink outlines to all shapes. The style should be reminiscent of 1940s surrealist sketches.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, sharp calligraphic title in solid white at the top. Add a secondary title in an outlined slab-serif font at a 45-degree angle in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the heart bright red and centrally located on the figure?
Are the background colors flat and unshaded?
Is the top text solid white with sharp, pointed terminals?
Is the bottom text angled and outlined?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the cubist distortion on the bull
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the bull to avoid direct copying
Exact letterforms of the custom calligraphy
Specific arrangement of the background geometric shapes

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn ink quality in the outlines

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white border is present around the entire image.
Check that the red heart is the most saturated element.
Verify that the text does not have any drop shadows.
Confirm the minotaur's horns are blue and curved.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cubist Figure + Flat Color Planes + Heavy Ink Outlines + Sharp Calligraphic Display Type + Diagonal Outlined Subtitle
